decks.notes: This Modern 1 vs 1 deck focuses on the Aggro archetype and utilizes the Cascade Crash strategy. The deck includes cards like Dead / Gone, Crashing Footfalls, Fire / Ice, and Violent Outburst to generate explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent. It also features cards such as Force of Negation, Mystical Dispute, and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck incorporates a mixture of lands including Boseiju, Who Endures, Ketria Triome, and Gemstone Caverns to enable a variety of spell options. With the inclusion of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Tishana's Tidebinder, this deck aims to maintain board presence and deal substantial damage quickly.

This deck focuses on casting cheap spells to trigger cascade abilities, allowing for powerful card advantage and tempo plays. Utilizing creatures like Shardless Agent and Crashing Footfalls, along with counterspells like Force of Negation, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of threats. With versatile spells like Fire / Ice and Dead / Gone, the deck can control the board while also applying pressure. By combining aggression with cascade mechanics, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and seize victory in the early game.

The main concept of this deck is to rapidly equip a creature with a Colossus Hammer and use its powerful abilities to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards like Esper Sentinel, Puresteel Paladin, and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip the hammer quickly. Cards like Surge of Salvation, Sigarda's Aid, and Shadowspear further enhance the effectiveness of the hammer. The deck also includes other artifacts like Gingerbrute, Kaldra Compleat, and Inkmoth Nexus to diversify the threats and increase the likelihood of success. The deck also has some protection and disruption elements with cards like Pithing Needle, Spell Pierce, and Spellskite.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cascade mechanics to quickly deploy threats and disrupt opponents, utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls. The deck also includes a mix of counter magic and versatile creatures like Brazen Borrower to control the game tempo. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Dead / Gone provide additional disruptive elements while still maintaining a fast pace. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption while maintaining a streamlined game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently using cards such as Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Arboreal Grazer, in order to get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield as soon as possible. Utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and gain extra mana, the deck aims to abuse powerful lands like The One Ring and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. With the ability to search for necessary lands and combo pieces, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and powerful finish.

The deck focuses on assembling a wide range of creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. It utilizes cards like Delighted Halfling, Grist the Hunger Tide, and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value and control the board. The key strategy involves tutoring for specific creatures using Chord of Calling, while also leveraging sacrifice effects with cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Blood Artist to disrupt the opponent and finish them off. This deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through its versatile creature toolkit.

This deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays using low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to pressure the opponent early on. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to keep the opponent off balance. The deck aims to maintain card advantage with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Not Dead After All while also utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Inti, Seneschal of the Sun to close out the game. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure and close out games quickly. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate while also generating card advantage with cards like Wrenn and Six. The inclusion of Urza's Saga allows for additional versatility and the ability to search for key artifacts to further strengthen the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It utilizes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure early on. Cards like Thoughtseize and Grief are used to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also benefiting from cards in their hand. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. Overall, the goal is to control the game early on and finish off the opponent quickly before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize, while ramping up mana with Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth. The deck also includes powerful control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to dominate the board. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and March of Wretched Sorrow to control the opponent's creatures, while also having access to land destruction with Field of Ruin. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponent with its strong control elements.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and casting powerful spells with Cascade mechanics, aiming to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent, the deck can generate a constant stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and bounce effects. The goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent and finish the game quickly before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a comeback.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creature cards to create a versatile toolbox approach, allowing for different combos and interactions depending on the situation. Grist, the Hunger Tide serves as a key piece, providing tokens and recursion abilities. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician provides additional value through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards. The deck also includes ways to tutor for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents with a wide range of creature options.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping mana and utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate explosive plays with Primeval Titan and lands with powerful effects. The goal is to assemble the right combination of lands to create a dominant board state and overwhelm the opponent with threats. By utilizing the unique abilities of the lands in the deck, such as bouncing lands for additional land drops or searching for utility lands, the deck aims to quickly establish control of the game and win through a powerful combo.

The deck revolves around using Chord of Calling to tutor for specific creatures that serve as a toolbox to either disrupt the opponent's game plan or assemble a combo win condition. The creatures in the deck have various abilities that can either generate value, provide additional resources, or create a win condition when combined together. By utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities, the deck can adapt to different board states and strategies, making it a versatile and resilient combo deck in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize, while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes ways to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt. Additionally, there are graveyard synergies with Dauthi Voidwalker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, allowing the deck to take advantage of its own resources while pressuring the opponent. The deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Hardened Scales enchantment to amplify the power and toughness of creatures on the battlefield. The main strategy is to quickly generate +1/+1 counters on creatures, particularly Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista, to create massive threats. The deck also utilizes Arcbound Ravager to distribute counters and manipulate the board state. Other key cards include Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, which can sacrifice artifacts for additional counters, and Urza's Saga, which can search for key artifacts. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggression and counter manipulation.
